subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Deforestation-Free Supply Chains
description: A fast breakdown of Deforestation-Free Supply Chains for builders.

hook.text: Your chocolate bar may have caused deforestation in West Africa. The cocoa supply chain often hides this link.

buildup.text: Agricultural commodities—soy, palm oil, cocoa, beef—drive 80% of global deforestation.

discovery.text: Deforestation-free sourcing traces commodities to their origin to verify no forests were cleared.

twist.text: Traceability is extremely hard. Commodities from different farms mix at processing facilities.

climax.text: The EU Deforestation Regulation requires companies to prove their imports are deforestation-free by 2025.

punchline.text: Know where it came from or don't sell it here.

quiz.question: What drives 80% of global deforestation?
options: Agricultural commodities like soy, palm oil, and beef
